summary: Move the -wa form to Detransitive Infectum-wa
rationale: The same entry attests ko-mǝtḥasadno as the present I envy, and mǝtḥasadli as the l-suffixed Preterit I envied. The example mǝtḥasadwayno has the present base plus -wa-, so it belongs in Detransitive Infectum-wa rather than plain Preterit. This proposal preserves the editor’s attested variant stem shape.
